summaryEn: Presidential and parliamentary elections are held on the same day every five years. The last joint election was 14 May 2023. The next ordinary election falls in 2028; the polling day is not printed. This release has the national page, 81 provinces, 973 districts, and 87 parliamentary constituencies, in Turkish and English.
llmsLine: Turkey in this release: national pages, 81 provinces, 973 districts (ilçe), and 87 parliamentary constituencies, in Turkish and English. Town, village, and neighbourhood pages are not published.
